title: papaver langeanum
intro: Papaver langeanum, commonly known as the Lange's poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). It is native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Papaver langeanum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide relief from various health conditions.
